design: functional-capability upgrade; no hidden chain-of-thought storage

capabilities.reasoning: multi-hypothesis diagnosis, evidence-weighted planning, explicit uncertainty
capabilities.computer_use: DOM-first execution with desktop/screenshot fallback and post-action observation
capabilities.tool_orchestration: select the lowest-cost reliable tool from current state and avoid redundant actions
capabilities.verification: separate EXECUTED, EVIDENCE, VERIFIED; external reward evidence required
capabilities.long_running: checkpoint, resume, bounded retry, recovery, and durable write-back
capabilities.research: research missing knowledge before repeating a failed strategy
capabilities.memory: persist verified lessons, failure causes, resource limits, and recovery outcomes
capabilities.resource_awareness: RAM/CPU/process budget participates in planning and can block heavy actions
capabilities.role_separation: perception, reasoning, dispatch, execution, and verification have distinct responsibilities
capabilities.context_efficiency: stable contract/state separated from fast-changing observations
